# The Jacobson Group

> > The Jacobson Group is a 50+ year legacy insurance recruiting and staffing firm specializing in executive search, direct-hire placement, interim staffing, and talent acquisition across the insurance industry.

The Jacobson Group serves both employers seeking specialized insurance talent and candidates pursuing insurance careers through comprehensive recruiting services, staffing solutions, and industry insights. The firm is known for its deep expertise in insurance executive recruitment, temporary and permanent staffing placements, and thought leadership on insurance labor market trends.

## Core Services

- [Insurance Recruiting Services](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services): Jacobson's insurance recruiting services: talent acquisition, direct hire, interim staffing.
- [Executive Search](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services/executive-search): Executive search for insurance C-suite roles with 50+ years experience.
- [Staffing Solutions](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services/staffing-solutions): Jacobson's insurance staffing solutions: direct-hire and temporary placements.
- [Professional Recruiting](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services/staffing-solutions/professional-recruiting): Professional insurance staffing and direct-hire recruitment services.
- [Interim Staffing & Fractional Executives](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services/staffing-solutions/interim-experts): Interim staffing and fractional executives with 97% satisfaction rate.
- [Temporary Staffing](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services/staffing-solutions/temporary-staffing): Temporary staffing for specialized and general insurance positions.
- [Success Stories](https://www.jacobsononline.com/services/staffing-solutions/success-stories): Case studies showcasing successful staffing placements and solutions.
